item.description: State Police arrested Robert Mears in Brandon for threatening a family member with a weapon. The incident happened Sunday evening on Forest Dale Road. Mears is held without bail and will face charges today.

Green Mountain Union High School's guidance department received the HCRS Ripple Impact Award. The team was recognized for exceptional support to students and families. They work closely with various school-based services to help students thrive.
Killington Resort will open for the season tomorrow the seventeenth. First chair will be at ten a.m. or possibly earlier. This is the resort's third winter under independent ownership.

Pawlet Public Library has hired its first shared directors, Heidi Hammell and Helen Wood. Wood will oversee operations and administration, while Hammell leads youth and community services. This new model replaces previous staffing roles to better serve the community.
